selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: Configuration sets accept_redirects=0 globally, by default, and for every interface; post-reboot values are 0 across all scopes.

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 source-routed packet acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: Configuration sets accept_source_route=0 globally, by default, and for every interface; post-reboot values are 0 across all scopes.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64.

Healthy baseline used boot ID d052eb57-c81d-4309-ae7f-bce362073ff9; reboot was acknowledged; new boot ID 46864720-7732-407f-9b93-8b8c76de572e was observed; systemd, NetworkManager, SSH, addressing, routing, persisted configuration, and hardened values fully recovered.

commands.command:
printf 'node=%s ip=%s
' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"; printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'kernel='; uname -r; printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s
' "$NAME" "$VERSION_ID"; sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route; printf '%s
' 'persistent declarations:'; grep -RHE '^[[:space:]]*net\.ipv4\.conf\.(all|default)\.(accept_redirects|accept_source_route)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d 2>/dev/null || true
